mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 PM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 88 degrees with overcast conditions at Harriet Park and a full moon lighting up the sky.

The City of Verona has announced that road surface treatments are scheduled for August 4 through 7, starting on Lincoln Street. Additionally, the city is offering a 100 dollar rebate program for residents who replace old, low-efficiency toilets with new high-efficiency models, along with a separate rebate program for installing rain barrels.

We have a packed schedule starting today with Yoga at Insight Wellness, Concerts in the Park, and Hop Haus Trivia. Tomorrow, look forward to live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, the Remote Area Medical Clinic, the Sugar River Paddle and Jamboree, and the Dane County Farmer's Market all take place on August 1.
Looking at the weekly report, officers handled a range of calls including a notable incident on July 26 where a driver was arrested for an O W I after being clocked at 97 miles per hour.
Enjoy a scoop of the Caramel Turtle flavor of the day before they close at 10 PM. You can also find Kona Ice at Fireman's Park today from 12:30 PM to 4:30 PM for more frozen fun.
